news.title: Mesiniaga sees steady outlook despite supply chain risks

recent_en: MSNIAGA saw boardroom changes in October 2026, disclosed a material litigation in November, and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November. News noted a steady outlook despite supply chain risks.
notable_en: The company announced a material litigation on 17 November 2026.
Two boardroom changes occurred on 27 October 2026, involving Encik Khairul Azizi bin Ismail and Puan Shazurawati binti Abdul Karim.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 17 November 2026.
